title: The Betrayal & The Long Chains
description: Colonial patrols and British askari intercept Mekatilili and Wanje in the coastal hills. Refusing to yield, they are sentenced to deportation over 1,000 kilometers away.

objectives.description: Confront the colonial detachment under Captain Phillips.
Reaffirm the sacred covenant with Wanje wa Mwadorikola before deportation.
Begin the forced deportation march toward the western highlands.

reward_text: Mekatilili and Wanje stand unbroken even as they are led away into exile.
